title: Miniland Educational Recalls Moogy Plush Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The red button on the Moogy plush toy's left pocket and the snap button on the right pocket can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,000 (in addition, 100 were sold in Canada).

title: Academy Sports + Outdoors Recalls Marinade Injectors Due to Ingestion Hazard
summary: The injectors can have small metal shavings left inside during the manufacturing process. The metal shavings can be deposited into the marinade during use and ingested by consumers. Units: About 3,500.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls Infant Cradle Swings Due to Fall Hazard
summary: When the seat peg is not fully engaged the seat can fall unexpectedly, posing a risk of injury to the child. Units: About 34,000.

title: Staples Recalls Back in Motion Office Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair can tip over when leaning back, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: Rollerblade USA Recalls Helmets Due to Head Injury Hazard
summary: The helmet's plastic shell can crack where the straps attach, causing the helmet to shift and move on the wearer's head. This can result in a head injury hazard to the user in the event of a fall. Units: About 500.

title: Yamaha Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: Water can get into the throttle cable and if it freezes during cold weather, the ice can prevent the throttle from returning to idle. This can cause the rider to lose control, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 7,000.

title: Coleman Recalls Flashlights Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 8,500 in the United States (in addition, about 500 were sold in Canada).

title: GolfBuddy GPS Bands Recalled by Deca International Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The band charging ports can produce an electrical charge to exposed skin, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: IKEA Recalls Children's Bat Cape Costumes Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The fabric hook and loop fastener at the neck of the bat cape can fail to detach readily during use, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 11,000 (in addition, 750 in Canada).

title: Rainbow Play Systems Reannounces Recall of Plastic Yellow Trapeze Rings Due to Low Response Rate; Manufactured by Nylacarb
summary: The rings can unexpectedly crack or break during use, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 121,000 pairs of rings in the United States (in addition about 6,500 were sold in Canada and about 5,500 in Mexico).

title: Ivanka Trump Scarves Recalled by GBG Accessories Group Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The scarves do not meet the federal flammability standards for clothing textiles, posing a burn risk. Units: About 20,000.

title: Nipoamerican Recalls Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: All Niposul and NipoFlorida Elegance, Elegance Gold, and Evolution mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses. Units: About 325.

title: Eleanor Rose Recalls Children’s Loungewear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The loungewear fails to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 5,900.

title: Givenchy Recalls Men's Silk T-Shirts Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
summary: The T-shirts fail to meet the federal flammability standard for wearing apparel and pose a risk of burn injury to consumers. Units: About 60.

title: Cub Cadet Recalls Challenger Off-Road Utility Vehicles Due To Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The parking brake cable can fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1,300.

title: Alltrade Tools Recalls Ratcheting Tie Downs Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Sam's Club
summary: The ratchet handle can fail during use, releasing the secured load, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 129,000.

title: One World Technologies Recalls Snow Blowers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The snow blowers can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 300 (in addition, about 370 were sold in Canada).

title: Stile Products Expands Recall of Tern Folding Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bike's frame can crack at the hinge on the top tube, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 220 (in addition, about 175 were recalled in June 2013).

title: SouvNear Recalls Women’s Scarves Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The scarves do not meet the federal flammability standard for clothing textiles, posing a burn risk. Units: About 650.

title: YTL International Recalls Drywall Lifts Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The drywall lifts can fail during use causing the load of drywall to fall onto the lift operator, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 17,000 (in addition, 2,700 were sold in Canada).

title: Brunton Outdoors Recalls Battery Packs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power packs' lithium ion polymer batteries can overheat and catch on fire during charging, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,050 in the U.S. (in addition, about 40 were sold in Canada).

title: Flying Tiger Copenhagen Recalls Wooden Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Parts of the wooden toys can become detached, resulting in small pieces that can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,000.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard; Severe Burn Injuries, One Death Reported
summary: The recalled ROVs can catch fire while consumers are driving, posing fire and burn hazards to drivers and passengers. Units: About 133,000.
